title: pinus radiata subsp. cedrosensis
intro: Pinus radiata subsp. cedrosensis, commonly known as Cedros Island redwood or Cedros pine, is a subspecies of the Monterey pine that is native to Cedros Island in Mexico. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against chronic diseases such as cancer, cardiovascular disease, and neurodegenerative disorders. The therapeutic actions of Pinus radiata subsp. cedrosensis include its ability to inhibit the growth of tumor cells, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include terpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
